FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 286
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Danny Crawford
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/18/2026
House Bill 286 as introduced would decrease utility gross receipts (UGR) tax and utility service
use (USU) tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund (ETF) by an undetermined amount
dependent upon the the cost and amount of electricity, natural gas, and telephone or other
connective services used for radio and television broadcast stations, which would be exempted
from these taxes by this bill.
